templates.name: JUnit5 in-framework test class with injection
templates.description: Test class running inside OSGi framework with injected BundleContext and service. @ExtendWith lines optional (annotations self-register) but shown for clarity.

templates.name: Integration-test bndrun (maven bnd-testing flavor)
templates.description: Launch descriptor for running the -tests bundle inside Equinox with the JUnit platform tester. -runbundles left to the resolver.
templates.template:
-tester: biz.aQute.tester.junit-platform

-runvm: -enableassertions:${assert-package-prefix}...

-runfw: org.eclipse.osgi
-resolve.effective: active
-runproperties: \
	osgi.console=

-runrequires: \
	bnd.identity;id='${tests-bundle-id}'

-runstartlevel: \
	order=sortbynameversion,\
	begin=-1
# -runbundles computed by resolver: bnd resolve resolve -W -b <this file>

params.name: assert-package-prefix
params.description: Package tree to enable JVM assertions for

params.name: tests-bundle-id
params.description: Identity of the tests bundle (artifactId-tests under maven)

templates.name: bnd workspace test project bnd.bnd
templates.description: Separate test project in a bnd workspace: Test-Cases discovery via @Testable hierarchy scan, buildpath with BSNs and workspace macros.

params.name: impl-project-bsn
params.description: Implementation project this test depends on (build order only)

params.name: api-project-bsn
params.description: API bundle on the buildpath — never the impl

templates.note: ${classes...}, ${junit}, ${osgitest} are bnd/workspace macros, NOT template parameters — copy literally. Only names listed in params are placeholders.

templates.name: Custom AssertJ assertion pair for an OSGi type
templates.description: Abstract+concrete AssertJ pair following the osgi-test assertion module convention.

params.name: type-simple-name
params.description: Simple name of asserted OSGi type

params.name: actual-getter
params.description: Getter on actual used for comparison

params.name: assertion-property
params.description: Human-readable property name in failure message
